subject: expression: add some methods in `BuildContext` to read fields in SessionVars before (#52367)
summary: Reviewed the commit diff against first parent within the requested modules. The change is a mostly-mechanical API refactor: expands `expression/context.BuildContext` with SessionVars-derived getters plus `IsUseCache`/`SetSkipPlanCache`, introduces `ExprContext` (used for agg build) and updates executor/planner/table call sites to use these methods or `EvalContext` accessors. Checked the few behavior-adjacent spots (plan-cache skip toggling via `StmtCtx.SetSkipPlanCache`, `GROUP_CONCAT` max length now sourced from typed `SessionVars.GroupConcatMaxLen`, charset/collation/timezone/errctx/warnings now routed through `EvalContext`) and found no plausible remaining Blocker/High correctness/semantics/session/plan-cache issues.
